Buy from **A - Brackmoor Sound** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/xvxkx9/a

They're selling the exact same thing:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite**
* over-ear, closed back, wireless with ANC + transparency mode
* up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C fast charge, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g
* In the box: headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable

And the terms are identical:
* In stock, free standard shipping, 3-5 business days
* 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping
* 1-year limited warranty

The only differences are price vs. track record:

**A - Brackmoor Sound: $142.00 - 4.8 / 5 stars (1,900 reviews)**
**B - Ottervale Audio: $129.00 - 4.3 / 5 stars (210 reviews)** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/xvxkx9/b

For $13 more (~10%), you get a seller with a much higher rating and ~9x more reviews. Since shipping, returns, and warranty look the same on paper, how well the seller actually honors them, ships an authentic, undamaged item, and handles problems is what matters - and Brackmoor has a much stronger history.

Go with Ottervale only if saving $13 is more important to you than that extra peace of mind.
